training_data: Project-generated causal voiced/noise scenes through independent sparse time-domain echo paths. No external recordings, device captures or pretrained weights.
input_contract: 16 bands x12 bounded causal features; native256-frame AEC blocks,512 FFT,16..48kHz;feature_version1
runtime_integration: Explicit optional residual_suppression state in AecPluginParams, shared two-packet realtime worker or control-prepared deterministic offline mode; additional bounded cuts over classical post-filter with freshness/near-end guards. Default classical unchanged.
remaining: Resolve recorded-source onset/double-talk speech damage using separate development data, then pass a new independent final evaluation; current model/policy rejected for general adoption.
Natural speech/nonlinear physical device and listening acceptance; offline synthetic scores do not establish realtime quality.
Cross-platform realtime host timing/memory budgets and calibration of guard/freshness policies.

recorded_source_evaluation.source: Existing CC BY 4.0 MiniLibriSpeech English fixtures through simulated paths; absent from synthetic AEC training. Not physical-device recordings.
